task: Review ALL documentation files in this repo and update them so every statement accurately describes the CURRENT codebase. The doc files in scope (and ONLY these may be modified): README.md, AGENTS.md, src/README.md, src/components/README.md, src/components/cv/README.md, src/layouts/README.md, src/pages/_README.md, scripts/README.md, docs/README.md, docs/depth-parallax-research.md, docs/docker.md, docs/performance.md. HARD CONSTRAINT: do NOT touch anything under src/content/ (no .mdx content files), and do NOT modify any code, config, or test files - docs only. For each doc file, read it fully, cross-check its claims against the actual repo (read the code/config it references), and fix what is stale or wrong: (a) version claims must match package.json (Astro 7.1.5, Tailwind 4.2.2, React 19.x - AGENTS.md currently says 'Astro 6', which is wrong); (b) component/layout/script inventories must match the actual files on disk - add missing ones, remove dead ones; (c) package.json script names and behaviors cited in docs must match; (d) the Pagefind search docs must reflect the CURRENT implementation: markup in src/components/Pagefind.astro references src/scripts/pagefind.ts via <script src>, and astro.config.mjs has a vite.build.assetsInlineLimit veto that keeps scripts emitted as chunks (src/README.md section 'Search' around line 255-267 still describes the old inline-script design - stale); (e) remove or correct references to files/flags/scripts that no longer exist. Preserve each file's existing structure, tone, and formatting conventions - surgical edits, not rewrites. Keep mermaid diagrams syntactically valid. Do not invent features; if a doc describes something the code no longer does, fix the doc, not the code. VERIFY: bun x prettier --check on every file you edited must pass, and .pi/check-doc-refs.sh must pass.

sensors.name: format
sensors.cmd: bun x prettier --check README.md AGENTS.md src/README.md src/components/README.md src/components/cv/README.md src/layouts/README.md src/pages/_README.md scripts/README.md docs/README.md docs/depth-parallax-research.md docs/docker.md docs/performance.md
sensors.hint: Docs must stay prettier-clean. Run bun x prettier --write on the file(s) you edited.

sensors.name: doc-refs
sensors.hint: A doc references a repo path that does not exist. Fix the reference to point at the real path (check with ls/rg), or remove it if the referenced thing is gone.

sensors.name: no-stale-astro-version
sensors.cmd: ! rg -q 'Astro 6\b' AGENTS.md README.md src/README.md src/components/README.md src/layouts/README.md scripts/README.md docs/README.md docs/depth-parallax-research.md docs/docker.md docs/performance.md
sensors.hint: The site runs Astro 7.1.5 (see package.json). Update stale 'Astro 6' version claims.

sensors.name: judge
sensors.cmd: bun ~/.pi/agent/skills/self-correcting-loop/judge.ts --model openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 --spec 'The diff updates documentation (*.md files) to match the current codebase. Read the actual repo files to verify. PASS only if ALL hold: (1) every doc statement in the diff is factually correct against the current code - spot-check versions against package.json (Astro 7.1.5), the Pagefind implementation (markup in src/components/Pagefind.astro + logic in src/scripts/pagefind.ts via <script src>, assetsInlineLimit script-inlining veto in astro.config.mjs), and any component/script inventories against the files on disk; (2) no file under src/content/ is modified; (3) no code/config/test files are modified - docs only; (4) the diff does not delete substantive documentation without an accurate replacement; (5) no new factual errors are introduced. FAIL on any factual error about the current codebase.'
sensors.hint: The judge found doc claims that do not match the current codebase. Read the cited code and correct the doc statements - do not argue with the judge by weakening the spec.
